messages:
Ava (PM): quick one — infra pushed our dedicated capacity cut by two weeks. We need to rebaseline the MVP so engineering can focus. quick proposals?
Marcus (Eng): ack. can we list the absolute must-haves vs things we can punt to v1?
Priya (Eng-Infra): infra delay is due to driver cert testing. timeline shift ~+14d if we keep current stack. we can parallelize a small subset if we reduce GPU footprint.
Lina (Design): from UX: core chat flow + persistence are must-haves. advanced tenant settings and analytics UI can go to v1.
Tom (Product): propose decision heuristic: user-facing core paths with no workaround stay in MVP. admin/ops, advanced telemetry, and nonblocking integrations => v1.
Ava (PM): ok propose initial cutlist: 
- KEEP: core generation, chat sessions, prompt history, API keys + basic usage dashboards
- CUT->v1: tenant-level analytics page, advanced RBAC settings, in-console quantization toggles, multi-region failover UI
Marcus (Eng): technical caveat: removing RBAC reduces some engineering dependency, but we still need scoped tokens for security. propose: keep scoped tokens (API-only), defer UI.
Priya (Eng-Infra): for the parallel path, we can enable a reduced GPU profile (lower batch sizes + 4bit quant) to serve MVP traffic for smaller tenants. that saves ~40% infra time. requires a quantization QA pass.
Zoë (QA): note: quant + lower batch sizes increases hallucination risk. need 2 small eval suites run: perf/latency and quality/regression on 50 prompts. ETA 3 days.
Ava (PM): decision: agree to defer tenant analytics + admin UI to v1; keep scoped tokens; enable reduced GPU profile with QA gate. timeline delta +10d (net) vs original. Anyone object?
Marcus (Eng): :thumbsup: fine. will add a feature flag and a fallback model path.
Lina (Design): :thumbsup: will create a minimal in-app banner that explains limited admin features so pilot customers aren't surprised.
Tom (Product): update acceptance criteria doc: "MVP must support 99% of core flows for single-tenant pilots without admin UI; metrics available via API; rollback path to full infra if perf drops."
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline queued for branch "mvp-slim-profile" — CI checks started.
Zoë (QA): scheduling the two eval runs, will post results in #eng-ml when done.
Ava (PM): I'll update roadmap and ping sales + a couple pilot customers about the scope change. thanks team — please add any risks ASAP.
Marcus (Eng): risk: we might see a ~15% increase in token cost per request in reduced-profile mode; Ops to monitor cost metrics per token.
Priya (Eng-Infra): noted. I'll add an alert for cost/tps ratio and automatic rollback threshold.
Ava (PM): perfect. closing this sync — will file the cutlist in the milestone doc and tag v1 items.
thread_preview: Ava asks to rebaseline MVP after infra delay; team agrees to defer admin/analytics to v1, enable reduced GPU profile with QA gate, and update acceptance criteria and monitoring.
